title: How do you decide between client-side and server-side validation?
description: Use both: client-side for UX, server-side for security and data integrity.

data.text: **Question:** How do you decide between client-side and server-side validation?
Use both. Client-side validation improves UX by giving instant feedback. Server-side validation is the security boundary that protects data integrity.

items: Client-side: required fields, format checks, immediate feedback
Server-side: business rules, database constraints, authorization
Never trust client input — attackers can bypass JavaScript
Return consistent validation errors from the server
Share validation rules when possible (Zod, FluentValidation)
